titre: Devoir de synthèse n°2 - Anglais (1ère année secondaire)

exercices.enonce:
TEXT
Volunteering is becoming more and more popular among young people, and this is very positive. When students give some of their free time to help others, everyone benefits. First, volunteers develop important human values such as solidarity, generosity and respect. Second, by helping people in need, young people gain useful experience and feel useful to their society. Finally, volunteering allows them to meet people from different backgrounds and to make new friends. In my opinion, schools should encourage students to join associations instead of spending all their time in front of screens. A young person who helps others today will become a responsible citizen tomorrow.

I. READING COMPREHENSION (6 marks)
1) What is becoming popular among young people?   (1,5 marks)
2) Give two benefits of volunteering mentioned in the text.   (2,5 marks)
3) What does the writer think schools should do?   (2 marks)

II. LANGUAGE (6 marks)
1) Complete with "should": Schools ______ encourage students to volunteer.   (1,5 marks)
2) Give the comparative form: Volunteering is becoming more and ______ (popular).   (1,5 marks)
3) Complete with a relative pronoun (who / which): A young person ______ helps others will become a responsible citizen.   (1,5 marks)
4) Give the opposite of "generosity" = ______.   (1,5 marks)

III. WRITING (8 marks)
"Should young people do volunteer work?" Write a composition (about 12 lines) giving your opinion, with at least two arguments and examples. Use linkers (first, second, finally…).
